name: Hvedrung Muspelheim
original_name: ヴェズルング＝ムスペルヘイム
source:
By causing a rapid stream within Loki's royal blood, the slumbering God of Armageddon will awaken and manifest in the world of the living. Despite sharing the same body, his strength and personality are that of a completely different being.

「Heh, who cares about the difficult stuff and minor details! Let's just enjoy this fight!」

Weapon name: Varanart
